# The question

P.Oxy. 5292 preserves twelve intact trimeters of Sophocles' *Tereus* and
seventeen damaged ones (vv. 13–29). Several restorers have filled the damaged
verses: W. B. Henry, the Stoicheia fill-in model, and judge-steered Markov
walks. Which topics does each restorer put into each lost verse, and does that
differ from what Sophocles writes elsewhere?

# The model

Every lemma of the vocabulary belongs to exactly one of $K$ semantic clusters
(word2vec on the lemmatised Greek corpus, Ward's method, cut at $K = 40$, one
rare-lemma cluster dropped). A **document** is $N$ consecutive topic-bearing
lemmata of a stream, and its topic counts are

$$\mathbf n \mid \theta \sim \mathrm{Multinomial}(N, \theta), \qquad
  \theta \sim \mathrm{Dirichlet}(\alpha \mathbf 1).$$

The Dirichlet is conjugate to the multinomial, so the posterior is exact,

$$\theta \mid \mathbf n \sim \mathrm{Dirichlet}(\alpha \mathbf 1 + \mathbf n),$$

and needs no sampler beyond `rgamma`. A **cell** (one lacuna, one restorer) is
the equal mixture of its documents' posteriors: its spread is the spread
between restorations plus the Dirichlet uncertainty of each. Sophocles' extant
trimeters are treated the same way, and a cell is compared with them by
$P(\theta_k^{\text{cell}} > \theta_k^{\text{Soph}})$ over paired draws and by
the lift of the posterior means.

# Data

The dataset `Urdatorn/bsda-miniproject-2026` on the Hugging Face Hub: one bag
of content lemmata per restored verse, the vocabulary with its cluster labels,
and the corpus of the three tragedians. The chunk below downloads the three
files (20 MB) into `data/` the first time the report is knitted.

```{r download}
# the data directory is not in the repository: fetch the dataset if needed
hub <- "https://huggingface.co/datasets/Urdatorn/bsda-miniproject-2026"
dir.create(params$data, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
for (f in c("vocab.json", "corpus.parquet", "imputations.parquet")) {
  if (!file.exists(file.path(params$data, f))) {
    download.file(paste(hub, "resolve/main", f, sep = "/"),
                  file.path(params$data, f), mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  }
}
```

```{r data}
vocab  <- fromJSON(file.path(params$data, "vocab.json"))
corpus <- read_parquet(file.path(params$data, "corpus.parquet"))
imp    <- read_parquet(file.path(params$data, "imputations.parquet"))
# a bag -> its lemma indices (0-based), counts expanded
stream <- function(tab) rep(unlist(tab$lemma_idx), unlist(tab$count))
# lemma indices -> topic labels; lemmata without a topic are not observations
topics <- function(s) { t <- vocab$cluster_K40[s + 1]; t[!is.na(t)] }
tragic <- filter(corpus, source %in% c("sophocles", "aeschylus", "euripides"))
# topics in order of their mass in the tragic corpus
names_ <- names(sort(table(topics(stream(tragic))), decreasing = TRUE))
K <- length(names_)
cat(K, "topics;", nrow(vocab), "lemmata,", sum(!is.na(vocab$cluster_K40)),
    "with a topic;", nrow(imp), "restored verses\n")
```

# Documents and the exact posterior

```{r model}
n <- params$n; alpha <- params$alpha; draws <- params$draws
max_docs <- params$max_docs

# cut a topic stream into documents of exactly n labels, at most `limit`
docs <- function(s, limit, shuffle = FALSE) {
  x <- topics(s); if (shuffle) x <- sample(x)
  m <- length(x) %/% n; if (m == 0) return(list())
  d <- split(x[seq_len(m * n)], rep(seq_len(m), each = n))
  if (m > limit) d <- d[sort(sample(m, limit))]
  d
}
rdirichlet <- function(S, par) {
  g <- matrix(rgamma(S * length(par), par), S, byrow = TRUE); g / rowSums(g)
}
# the exact posterior Dirichlet(alpha + n) of every document, stacked
posterior <- function(d) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(d, function(x) {
    rdirichlet(draws, alpha + tabulate(match(x, names_), K))
  }))
}
# a cell: its mixture of posteriors, and paired draws against the baseline
cell <- function(d, base = NULL) {
  if (!length(d)) return(NULL)
  P <- posterior(d); s <- list(n_docs = length(d), mean = colMeans(P), P = P)
  if (!is.null(base)) {
    B <- base[sample(nrow(base), nrow(P), replace = TRUE), ]
    s$p_above <- colMeans(P > B); s$lift <- colMeans(P) / colMeans(base)
  }
  s
}
# the tilt flag is null for Stoicheia and the candidates
untilted <- function(tab) filter(tab, !coalesce(style_tilted, FALSE))
```

```{r cells}
soph <- cell(docs(stream(filter(corpus, source == "sophocles")), 4 * max_docs))
walk <- untilted(filter(imp, restorer == "walk"))
henry <- arrange(filter(corpus, source %in% c("intact", "henry")), line)
cells <- list(walk = cell(docs(stream(walk), 2 * max_docs), soph$P),
              henry = cell(list(topics(stream(henry))), soph$P))
for (v in 13:29) for (r in c("stoicheia", "candidates", "walk")) {
  fills <- untilted(filter(imp, verse == v, restorer == r))
  cells[[paste(v, r)]] <- cell(docs(stream(fills), max_docs, shuffle = TRUE),
                               soph$P)
}
rows <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cells), function(cl) {
  s <- cells[[cl]]; if (is.null(s)) return(NULL)
  tibble(cell = cl, topic = names_, n_docs = s$n_docs, mean = s$mean,
         p_above_sophocles = s$p_above, lift = s$lift)
}))
write.csv(rows, file.path(params$out, "posterior.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Sophocles' baseline

```{r baseline, fig.height = 5}
tibble(topic = factor(names_, rev(names_)), mean = soph$mean) |>
  ggplot(aes(topic, mean)) + geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "posterior mean of theta",
       title = sprintf("Sophocles, %d documents", soph$n_docs)) +
  theme_minimal(9)
```

# Topics raised above Sophocles

Topics with $P(\theta_k^{\text{cell}} > \theta_k^{\text{Soph}}) \ge 0.9$,
with the lift of the posterior mean and the mean itself.

```{r raised, results = "asis"}
raised <- rows |> filter(p_above_sophocles >= 0.9) |>
  arrange(cell, desc(lift)) |> group_by(cell, n_docs) |>
  summarise(raised = paste0(topic, " (", sprintf("%.1f", lift), "×, ",
                            sprintf("%.2f", mean), ")", collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop")
cat(sprintf("- **%s** (%d documents): %s", raised$cell, raised$n_docs,
            raised$raised), sep = "\n")
```

# Lift of every topic in every cell

```{r heatmap, fig.height = 9}
rows |> separate(cell, c("verse", "restorer"), sep = " ", fill = "right") |>
  mutate(restorer = coalesce(restorer, verse),
         verse = ifelse(verse %in% c("walk", "henry"), "all", verse),
         topic = factor(topic, names_), label = paste(verse, restorer)) |>
  ggplot(aes(label, topic, fill = pmin(lift, 4))) + geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(midpoint = 1, low = "steelblue", high = "firebrick",
                       name = "lift\n(capped at 4)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Posterior mean relative to Sophocles") +
  theme_minimal(7) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

# Where the walk and Henry stand

```{r pooled}
rows |> filter(cell %in% c("walk", "henry")) |> arrange(cell, desc(lift)) |>
  group_by(cell) |> slice_head(n = 5) |>
  select(cell, topic, mean, p_above_sophocles, lift) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
